info.name: vision_api
info.description: OCR API exposing /health and /ocr. /ocr is a multipart form: provide either image_bytes (base64 string) or image_file (file upload). image_file accepts any format the selected engine supports — images, PDFs, and (Kreuzberg only) office docs, HTML, email, archives, etc. Non-image inputs return per-line text predictions with zero bbox. engine selects between Kreuzberg (default) and Paddle.

variable.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (PNG/JPEG). May include a data URI prefix like 'data:image/png;base64,...'.

formdata.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (optionally with a data URI prefix). Checked first; if non-empty, image_file is ignored.
Float between 0.0 and 1.0. Predictions below this confidence are dropped.
One of: Kreuzberg | Paddle. Default: Kreuzberg.
Paddle-only HQ mode (PaddleOCRVL with doc orientation/unwarp/seal recognition). Slower. Ignored by Kreuzberg. Default: false.
File to OCR (image, PDF, office doc, HTML, email, ...). Used when image_bytes is empty. Non-image inputs return per-line text predictions with zero bbox.

request.description: Run OCR on an uploaded image file (multipart upload).

formdata.description: File to OCR. Paddle natively handles images and PDFs.
When true, Paddle uses PaddleOCRVL with doc orientation/unwarp/seal recognition and OCR-for-image-block. Slower but higher quality on scanned/skewed inputs.

request.description: Run OCR using the Paddle engine (PaddleOCR). Requires container GPU access (run with --gpus all).

Demonstrates the validation error. Returns:
```
400 {"detail": "Either image_bytes (base64 string) or image_file (file upload) must be provided."}
```
